name: Meanstreak

identity.note: The registry's only other bare 'Meanstreak' is a 2002 OSW roster entry; different fed, different era, no operator/roster overlap evidenced.

tenures.note: Won the OWO World Heavyweight Championship from the Crow (26 Dec 1997), and retained it in a non-title grudge match against 'Iceman' Josh Cagle days later.

caption: Won the OWO World Heavyweight Championship from the Crow on 26 December 1997 and retained it days later against 'Iceman' Josh Cagle in a non-title grudge match.

name: The Crow

identity.note: A widely-reused period gimmick name across this era's e-feds; no operator/roster overlap evidenced with any of the above.

tenures.note: Lost the OWO World Heavyweight Championship to Meanstreak in a First Blood match (26 Dec 1997).

name: Icicle

tenures.note: Leader of the ICE stable's surviving members; attacked OWO President the Inquisitor on-air after a dispute over an injured stablemate's own match, then was himself attacked by the Hell's Angels security detail alongside two other former ICE members.

caption: A wrestler billed by OWO in the surviving 1997 Usenet record (1997).

name: The Inquisitor

identity.note: A common authority-figure title; different fed, no operator/roster overlap evidenced.

tenures.note: OWO's own on-air president; attacked by Icicle during the 28 Dec 1997 broadcast after refusing to book an injured wrestler.

name: Terminator

identity.note: A common gimmick name; different fed, no operator/roster overlap evidenced.

tenures.note: Won by submission over Virus (28 Dec 1997); defeated a returning Blizzard in seven seconds and then beat Raven for the OWO Xtreme Heavyweight Title by countout, a finish that does not change the title (30 Dec 1997).

caption: A wrestler billed by OWO in the surviving 1997 Usenet record (1997).

name: Raven

tenures.note: Billed OWO Xtreme Heavyweight Champion and member of the Darkside's Domain stable; retained the title against Terminator by countout (30 Dec 1997).

caption: Billed OWO Xtreme Heavyweight Champion and a member of the Darkside's Domain stable, retaining the title against Terminator by countout on 30 December 1997.
